medusa

medusa (Multilevel Event-Related Deconvolved Signal Analysis) is an R package for hemodynamic response estimation, regularized BOLD deconvolution, event-locked alignment, operator-based epoch de-mixing, observation-noise propagation, connectivity disattenuation, and split-wise multilevel modeling (mixed_by, jlmer, meta_mixed_by) of fMRI time series.

medusa was extracted from fmri.pipeline so that event-locked deconvolution and multilevel trajectory workflows can be installed and maintained independently of voxelwise FSL/AFNI/SPM GLM cluster pipelines.

Installation 

install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("HallquistLab/medusa")

Core Workflow

  1. NIfTI matrix I/O, cross-run HRF & AR(pp) noise estimation: read_nifti_ts(), write_nifti_ts(), hrf_library(), estimate_crossrun_hrf()
  2. Deconvolution: deconvolve_crossrun_hrf(), deconvolve_reglin(), deconvolve_nlreg(), deconvolve_nlreg_resample(), voxelwise_deconvolution()
  3. Event-locked alignment & epoch de-mixing: align_medusa_ts(), get_medusa_interpolated_ts(), evt_align_decon_files(), run_decon_alignment(), decon_epoch_regression(), fmri_ts, event_lock_ts()
  4. Diagnostics & connectivity repair: diagnose_crossrun_recovery(), deconvolution_impulse_diagnostics(), decon_connectivity_repair(), medusa_between_subject_repair()
  5. Multilevel trajectory & joint multi-lag inference: mixed_by(), jlmer(), meta_mixed_by(), medusa_fit_mmom(), medusa_multilag_infer(), backproject_medusa()

Documentation

MEDuSA documentation includes a comprehensive Quarto book alongside package vignettes:

  1. MEDuSA Quarto Book (book/): End-to-end methodological guide covering conceptual foundations, a reproducible worked example, dedicated chapters for all six pipeline steps (goals, input/output architecture, recommended settings, event-informed continuous deconvolution vs. blind deconvolution, epoch de-mixing, parcel panels, group multilevel & multi-lag trajectory inference, and disattenuated connectivity), measurement-error theory, and calibration diagnostics. Render locally from book/ with quarto render.
  2. Conceptual foundations: Package vignette introducing convolution, regularization, HRF learning, event mixing, units, duration, and precision-weight propagation.
  3. Worked workflows: Executable simulation and recipes for NIfTI inputs, file alignment, and downstream precision-weighted / ZCA-whitened multilevel models (mixed_by).
  4. Technical companion: Historical technical derivations and early validation notes.

See rendering instructions for producing the HTML vignettes and Quarto book from a checkout.
